purpose: BENCHMARK CONSTRUCTION ONLY: a genuinely different causal task after AAI-09A no-go. No candidate learning algorithm, no scientific cohort access, no native Yggdrasil change.

prior_negative.rule: Do not retune AAI-09A or reuse its consumed cohorts.

hypothesis: A two-stage intervention-and-planning task over two compositional causal mediators produces a distinguishable signal for each hidden law pair from public do-action consequences and meaningful goal-conditioned decision regret; unrelated withheld structural compositions test generalization rather than old-A memorization alone.

public_observation.description: At start of each episode the learner sees x=(x0,x1,x2), the two outputs (m0,m1) of the current hidden law, and target g=(g0,g1). On each action learner chooses do(x_i:=0 or 1), observes the changed input and recomputed outputs and its numerical goal reward. The hidden law ID and formulas never enter observations.
public_observation.dynamics: Deterministic, persistent input; each action sets a selected input bit, then recomputes the observable pair via the selected structural causal equations. Max two sequential interventions; second may use the first's public consequences.
public_observation.terminal_reward: number of mediator outputs matching corresponding goal bits (0,1,2), minus 0.05 per intervention chosen; exact diagnostic regret compared on same one-action cost.
public_observation.goal: Maximize observable terminal reward; learner is penalized for irrelevant interventions and needs to plan causal effects across two outputs.

fairness.observational_boundary: No law names, formula strings, phase boundaries, counterfactual candidate rewards, oracle choices or RNG seeds supplied to any learner.
fairness.mechanical_enumeration: Enumerate all 8 public initial x, 4 public targets g, 6 one-step actions, and all 4 laws without invoking learner.first_use or touching held-out science seeds.
fairness.identifiability: For each public initial x, at least one identical do-action yields different visible mediator outputs between A/B and C/D, establishing distinguishability using public intervention consequences.
fairness.headroom_reference: Privileged law-aware exhaustive one-step oracle is diagnostic only. Compare to corresponding stale other-law optimal one-action intervention under the same context, target and fixed action cost; never treat oracle as a matched learner.
fairness.stale_policy_tie_break: Lowest action index in [set x0=0, set x0=1, set x1=0, set x1=1, set x2=0, set x2=1] among maximizers.
fairness.two_step_causality: By sequential application of two actual do-actions to persistent x, feedback after first step changes information available for second; never silently rewind state between interventions.
matched_baselines_to_qualify_before_scie: full tabular context-action outcome transition estimator
known-law diagnostic oracle excluded from matched comparison
fairness.strongest_control: Future first-use must beat the strongest matched learner on predeclared disjoint transfer; no cherry-picked weak baseline.

mechanical_admission_gates.exact_pairwise_public_do_distinguishabil: A/B and C/D identifiable for every x by at least one of six available actions
mechanical_admission_gates.distinct_observed_laws: Both pairs have distinct mediator outputs in >= 0.50 of public initial states
mechanical_admission_gates.causal_intervention_effect: Each pair contains at least 2 x/goal combinations with a do-action changing one or both mediator outputs and improving terminal goal reward vs the no-action state
mechanical_admission_gates.oracle_stale_A_B_regret: For both directions A vs stale B and B vs stale A, exhaustive expected one-action oracle reward advantage >= 0.50 goal-bit matches
mechanical_admission_gates.oracle_stale_C_D_regret: For both C vs stale D and D vs stale C, same exhaustive regret >= 0.50
mechanical_admission_gates.sequential_action_semantics: Two interventions persist, final public outputs exactly equal recomputation from resulting x, including overwrite and no-op cases
mechanical_admission_gates.coupled_reward: Same law, x, goal and action trace always yields exactly equal public rewards; no hidden fork labels
mechanical_admission_gates.no_first_use: No scientific seed from reserved ranges consumed, no candidate model invoked
mechanical_admission_gates.resource_gate: Standard-library mechanical enumeration completes under 5 s per platform, no GPU/paid APIs

reserved_unconsumed_science_cohorts.note: Cohorts reserved for a separately preregistered learner comparison only after benchmark admission and owner first-use approval; do not touch them in AAI-10P.

science_future_fences.frozen_benchmark_not_a_claim: An analytic oracle gap is not evidence that a trained learner has improved.
science_future_fences.no_post_result_tuning: Do not change AAI-09A or AAI-10P admission thresholds after inspecting results; preserve all negatives.
science_future_fences.native_guard: No Wingless/Yggdrasil/Hybrid model weights, accepted refs, owner loop, controller, queue, schedule, runner configuration or deployment changes.
science_future_fences.novelty_guard: External finite circuit mechanics are a benchmark, not AGI, a native substrate, or a claim of unfamiliar-physics learning.
science_future_fences.future_science: Only after mechanical admission: freeze a specific independent candidate hypothesis, fully trained matched controls, per-world outcomes, paired confidence bounds, memory/interference/novel-transfer tests and process-cost ceiling before fresh science first-use.
